relationships.evidence_quote: DRG overexpression of ZNF382 blocked the SNL-induced increases in the levels of Cxcl13 mRNA and CXCL13 protein in the ipsilateral L4 DRG 7 d after SNL (Fig. 3, D and E).

relationships.subject: ZNF382
relationships.evidence_quote: Together, the evidence above indicates that ZNF382, HDAC1, and SETDB1 bind to each other as a complex, and this complex formation is reduced in injured DRG neurons after SNL.

relationships.subject: CXCL13
relationships.evidence_quote: Taken together, DRG up-regulated CXCL13 likely participates in the development and maintenance of neuropathic pain.

relationships.subject: ZNF382
relationships.evidence_quote: AAV5-Znf382 microinjection attenuated SNL-induced mechanical allodynia

key_findings: Nerve injury down-regulates ZNF382 in DRG neurons, and ZNF382 knockdown alone is sufficient to induce neuropathic pain-like behavior.
ZNF382 binds a Cxcl13 silencer and recruits HDAC1/SETDB1 to repress Cxcl13; its loss disinhibits CXCL13.
